metadata.title: Eribulin Monotherapy
metadata.indication: Locally advanced or metastatic breast cancer after progression on at least one chemotherapy regimen for advanced disease; prior anthracycline and taxane in the adjuvant or metastatic setting unless unsuitable. Adults with unresectable liposarcoma after anthracycline-containing treatment for advanced or metastatic disease unless unsuitable.
metadata.partial_assessment_note: Any independently actionable entered value is assessed; omitted domains remain unassessed and do not block a partial result.
metadata.partial_assessment_policy: Each entered value is assessed independently. Omitted domains remain unassessed and are never assumed normal.

catalogue_reconciliation.scope_note: The NCCP states that its website list is not comprehensive. This reconciliation does not assert that every possible national regimen is published online.

encoding_maturity.label: Source reconciled rule encoding · independent clinical and oncology pharmacy review pending
encoding_maturity.scope_note: Current NCCP source checked including indications, schedule, eligibility, independent partial inputs, recurrence dose ladder, organ impairment, cardiac exclusions and monitoring. Source gaps remain explicit review.

metadata.catalogue_source_check_scope: Catalogue presence and source link structure only; not rule level source fidelity.
metadata.schedule_summary: Eribulin 1.23 mg/m² (base) on days 1 and 8, every 21 days; continue until progression or unacceptable toxicity.
audited_eligibility: Locally advanced or metastatic breast cancer after progression on at least one chemotherapy regimen for advanced disease; prior anthracycline and taxane in the adjuvant or metastatic setting unless unsuitable.
Adults with unresectable liposarcoma after anthracycline-containing treatment for advanced or metastatic disease unless unsuitable.
audit_limitations: Independent consultant and oncology pharmacy validation pending; source reconciliation is not clinical-use authorisation.
Renal/hepatic percentages refer to the original dose; prior reductions and competing pathways require specialist reconciliation.
NCCP cycle-start blood tests supplemented by EMA SmPC FBC before every dose; ECG is risk-triggered, not a universal fixed-cycle schedule.
Current PDF footer states version 8, while its change log records version 9 dated 20/05/2026 for review-schedule amendment only; protocol identity remains nccp-00228-v8.
Table 2 lists CrCl >50 and <50 but leaves exactly 50 mL/min unspecified; equality and legacy ge50 input require review.

clinical_governance.prescriptive_authority: The treatment plan must be initiated by a Consultant Medical Oncologist or appropriately authorised specialist named in the current NCCP source.
clinical_governance.dose_modification_note: Use the most restrictive applicable component rule and confirm all dose changes against the current official NCCP PDF.
clinical_governance.disclaimer: Decision support reconciled to current NCCP 00228, footer version 8, on 18 October 2026. Independent clinical and pharmacy review remains pending. Confirm the current PDF and patient-specific plan.
clinical_governance.unlicensed_posology_note: Licensed 21-day eribulin posology; source-specific indications and eligibility still apply.

indications.description: Locally advanced or metastatic breast cancer after progression on at least one chemotherapy regimen for advanced disease; prior anthracycline and taxane in the adjuvant or metastatic setting unless unsuitable.

treatment.schedule_summary: Eribulin 1.23 mg/m² (base) on days 1 and 8, every 21 days; continue until progression or unacceptable toxicity.
treatment.dose_basis: eribulin base, not the 1.4 mg/m² mesylate salt convention
treatment.duration: Until disease progression or unacceptable toxicity
treatment.optional_combination_note: NCCP permits combination with trastuzumab under regimen 00200. This monotherapy card does not automatically add trastuzumab doses or monitoring; select and coordinate its separate protocol.

febrile_neutropenia.label: Prior ANC <1 ×10⁹/L complicated by fever or infection

mucositis_grade.label: Mucositis/stomatitis grade
mucositis_grade.assessment_guidance: Assess pain, ulceration and the effect on oral intake; distinguish altered diet from inability to eat or drink.

other_nonhaem_toxicity_grade.label: Worst relevant non-haematological toxicity
other_nonhaem_toxicity_grade.assessment_guidance: Identify the exact adverse event and grade it using its own CTCAE criteria, objective findings, intervention required and functional impact.

neuropathy_grade.label: Peripheral neuropathy grade
neuropathy_grade.assessment_guidance: Assess sensory/motor symptoms and their impact on instrumental and self-care activities.

options.label: CrCl exactly 50 mL/min: source boundary review

prolonged_anc_below_0_5_over_7d.label: Prior ANC <0.5 ×10⁹/L for more than 7 days

platelets_below_50_with_bleeding_or_tran.label: Prior platelets <50 ×10⁹/L with haemorrhage or blood/platelet transfusion

previous_grade_3_4_nonhaem.label: Grade 3 or 4 non-haematological toxicity in the previous cycle

current_eribulin_dose_level.label: Current prescribed eribulin dose (base; reconcile with event history)

qt_risk_factors.label: Heart failure, bradyarrhythmia, QT-prolonging medicines or electrolyte abnormality

uncorrected_low_electrolytes.label: Uncorrected low potassium, calcium or magnesium

acute_febrile_neutropenia.label: Current febrile neutropenia or suspected neutropenic sepsis

toxicity_recurred_at_reduced_dose.label: Qualifying toxicity recurred despite the documented reduced dose

renal_input.reason: Optional numerical entry is compared with the audited NCCP thresholds, retaining strict equality / source gaps without assigning an assumed band. Source-derived boundary scenarios cover this field.

output_templates.proceed: No encoded restriction was triggered in the entered domain(s). This is not an overall treatment clearance.
output_templates.coverage_gap: Only entered values were assessed; omitted clinically relevant domains remain unassessed.
output_templates.consultant_review: The entered value requires protocol-specific Consultant/pharmacy review.
output_templates.withhold: Withhold treatment and reassess according to the official NCCP pathway.
output_templates.dose_reduce: Apply the encoded dose-reduction pathway and confirm against the official source.
output_templates.contraindicated: The entered value triggers an encoded contraindication/exclusion.
output_templates.permanently_discontinue: The entered value triggers permanent discontinuation in the encoded pathway.

action.message: Arrange risk-directed ECG review at baseline and during treatment as clinically indicated; check QT-prolonging drugs and potassium, calcium and magnesium. These sources do not specify a universal cycle-day ECG or numeric QTc dose rule.

action.message: Correct low potassium, calcium or magnesium before initiating eribulin. During ongoing therapy, review the abnormality and ECG/QT risk before deciding on dosing; monitor these electrolytes periodically. This source does not define an automatic numeric dose reduction.

eligibility: Locally advanced or metastatic breast cancer after progression on at least one chemotherapy regimen for advanced disease; prior anthracycline and taxane in the adjuvant or metastatic setting unless unsuitable.
Adults with unresectable liposarcoma after anthracycline-containing treatment for advanced or metastatic disease unless unsuitable.

baseline: FBC, renal and liver profile (NCCP p2)
Potassium, calcium and magnesium: correct low levels before treatment (EMA SmPC §4.4; NCCP00743 p4)
ECG when heart failure, bradyarrhythmia, QT-prolonging medicines or electrolyte abnormalities are present (NCCP p2)
regular: FBC, renal and liver profile at the start of each cycle (NCCP p2)
FBC before every eribulin dose, including day 8 (EMA SmPC §4.4); confirm treatment-day counts and toxicity before dosing
Periodic potassium, calcium and magnesium; ECG when risk factors or clinical indications require it
Assess neuropathy, infection, mucositis and other toxicity before each dose
monitoring.disease: Scans and other response tests follow the consultant treatment plan. These sources do not mandate a fixed CT, tumour-marker, echo or DXA interval.
monitoring.additional_therapy: If trastuzumab is separately prescribed, add its own cardiac imaging and scheduling plan; this is not routine eribulin-only monitoring.

dose_modifications: Delay dosing for ANC <1 ×10⁹/L, platelets <75 ×10⁹/L or current grade 3–4 non-haematological toxicity.
Qualifying toxicity after treatment: 1.23 → 0.97 mg/m²; recurrence despite 0.97 → 0.62 mg/m²; recurrence despite 0.62: consider discontinuation. Do not re-escalate.
Renal/hepatic recommendations are relative to original dose, not compounded sequential reductions. Confirm individual dose and previous reductions with oncology pharmacy.

supportive_care.mapping_basis: Risk assigned from the most emetogenic active component and treatment phase.
supportive_care.supportive_medications_label: NCCP antiemetic guidance for low emetogenic risk

administration.notes: Dose is eribulin base. Do not dilute in glucose 5%. No home infusion pump is used.
